q: What do Matryoshka embeddings let you do?
options: Truncate vectors to fewer dimensions with only gradual quality loss
explain: Their leading dimensions already form a usable embedding.

q: How many bytes does a 1,024-dimension binary embedding take?
explain: 1,024 bits is 128 bytes, 32 times smaller than float32.

q: Why must you re-embed the whole corpus when switching embedding models?
options: Vectors from different models are not comparable
explain: Each model defines its own space.
